title: Why We Care So Much What People Think
hook: Your brain treats being ignored like physical pain. Here's the research that proves it.

key_facts.claim: Social exclusion activates the same brain regions as physical pain.
Even brief, anonymous exclusion from a game measurably lowers mood and self-esteem.

content_safety_notes: Ostracism research design historically involved a real hate group in one variant — depict only unmarked, abstract silhouette figures, no robes/insignia/identifiable iconography.
